secondary: other: navigation stall - base stopped ~1.2 m short of the fridge for ~320 steps (820-1136) while holding the bowl
what_happened: Layout 7 (island counter; side-by-side fridge with water dispenser ~3 m away), striped bowl_6, sweet potato, drumstick 012. Stage 0: sweet potato grasped 67, dropped into the bowl at 132. Stage 1: drumstick grasped 302 and released in the bowl at 395 (263 steps, normal). Stage 2: 440-546 the gripper pushed at the drumstick lying across the rim (holds with no lift) and a first close on the bowl at 505 did not lift it; at 604-616 it closed on the rim together with the drumstick and lifted the bowl (0.358 m). The bowl hung nearly vertical in the pinch, opening sideways, the drumstick wedged at the rim and the sweet potato inside. The base turned toward the fridge 700-800 and then stopped: the agent view is unchanged 820-1136 (~320 steps) with the bowl held at the robot's right side, ~0.86 m from the fridge interior. Gripper width stayed 0.019 the whole time; at 1136-1144 the bowl slipped out of the fingers (width 0.019 -> 0.003, no opening) and fell ~1.15 m to the floor. Both foods spilled. Afterwards (1400-1700) the base drove on to the fridge and the empty gripper reached into it, as if still carrying the bowl.
causal_chain: rim pinch grasp held the bowl near-vertical (604) -> base stalled 1.2 m short of the fridge for ~320 steps (820-1136) -> the bowl slipped out of the closed fingers at 1136-1144 and fell to the floor -> foods spilled, stages 0/1 undone -> robot continued to the fridge empty-handed
self_recovery: none: it never went back to the bowl on the floor; it continued the place motion at the fridge empty-handed.
